status: Engineering acceptance specification; full engine not implemented or measured.

requirements.quantization: Any format, including custom; approximately 4-bit resident weight footprint
requirements.quality_preference: Preserve quality; may slightly exceed 4-bit footprint
requirements.acceleration: MTP is optional and selected per workload; not an engine requirement
requirements.queueing: User explicitly allows queueing; report actual resident/running counts and queue delay.

performance_acceptance.reference: Existing local experimental vLLM; exact version, weights and metric definition must be pinned before comparisons.
performance_acceptance.evaluation: Report each input length separately. Client TTFT and executed-token model prefill TPS must not be mixed.

requirements.future_architectures: Multiple model architectures below 40B parameters on local Orin; phase one remains Qwen text only.

weight_accounting.optional_accelerator_weights: Report separately and in total resident bytes.

metrics.native_load: Process launch or explicit model load start to executable model Ready; split IO, context, allocation, module load, graph setup; cold versus warm OS page cache.
metrics.import: Original checkpoint to native quantized/prepacked artifacts; one-time calibration, conversion and kernel build reported separately.
metrics.first_request: Cold engine request total TTFT, first-use initialization/compilation/capture, actual prefill; cold versus warm compiler cache.
metrics.warm_prefill: Executed uncached input tokens divided by model prefill time; client TTFT reported separately.
metrics.warm_decode: Committed final output tokens divided by decode wall time; proposed/rejected tokens excluded; first output chunk accounted separately.
metrics.prefix: Request hit ratio, token reuse ratio, usable common prefix, lookup/restore/tail recompute/TTFT, checkpoint bytes and eviction.
metrics.concurrency: Total prefill and committed decode TPS, E2E throughput, TTFT and inter-token P50/P95, actual running count, queue delay, preemption and peak memory.

workloads.early_eos_policy: Fixed work performance suite and separate realistic EOS suite.

dispatch.primary: Ahead-of-time common row kernels and graph buckets.
dispatch.fallback: Precompiled symbolic-M kernel plus non-graph explicit-stream launch when needed.
dispatch.optional_jit: Asynchronous shape specialization, persisted cubin cache; new shape and cold-cache latency measured.

cache_contents: last hidden state for exact endpoint hit
prefix_state_design.correctness: Match cold execution logits within declared numeric tolerance after reuse, branching and eviction.

quality_evaluation: Fixed scenario requests and seed; compare token choice and baseline top-3 probabilities under identical teacher-forced histories. Full LLM benchmarks provide final quality validation.
BF16 reference on representative text, code and long-state workloads
Same-quantized-weight reference to isolate kernel implementation bugs
Model-level probability/perplexity and task metrics; local tensor error alone is insufficient
capacity: 128 requests is not equivalent to 128 resident contexts. KV and recurrent-state budgets, shared prefixes and scheduling must be reported explicitly.

experiments: full decode-step persistent kernel for M=1/2/4/8
fusion_candidates.decision: Measured semantic equivalence, wall time, memory, occupancy and preparation cost.
fusion_candidates.generation_contract: Model adapter -> semantic graph/explicit states -> TileLang lowering -> kernel graph or persistent schedule; no Qwen-specific common runtime.
